name: KiCad Blocks
description: Manage reusable, library-backed schematic functional blocks.

actions.name: KiCad Blocks Tasks
actions.description: Open the grouped task hub for less frequent and context-specific operations.

actions.name: Browse and Place Functional Blocks
actions.description: Search registered libraries, preview a block, configure it, and place it with KiCad's native chooser.

actions.name: Create Block from Selected Sheet
actions.description: Create and place a reusable block from the selected hierarchical sheet.

actions.name: Open Block Implementation
actions.description: Open the selected block's implementation for its configured variant.

actions.name: Place Imported Block Layout
actions.description: Move a previously imported KiCad Blocks PCB layout using the native cursor placement tool.
